purpose: Teach: ウニ/髭/洋書/つば/にんにく/マヨネーズ/ヤギ/泡盛

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがお寿司屋さんでウニを食べに行かれたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad went to the sushi place to eat uni.
lines.style: Warm, gentle opening. Soft smile in the voice — sharing a small memory with someone she cares about. Unhurried pacing, like she's savoring the telling.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんの髭、ちくちくして面白いよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Grandpa's beard is prickly — it tickles!
lines.style: Bright, innocent delight. Quick energy. The genuine small laugh of a child discovering something tactile and funny. Not performed, just real wonder.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがお洒落な洋書を本棚に並べてらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad arranged all these fancy foreign books on the bookshelf.
lines.style: Same warm reflection as before. Noticing detail with affection. Slight emphasis on the care it took — not criticizing, just observing something he cares about.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんがお茶のつばが飛ばないように気を付けてって
lines.en: Mei-sis, Grandpa told me to be careful so I don't splash tea everywhere.
lines.style: Quiet, thoughtful observation. A child understanding that grown-ups have small worries too. Slightly serious — he's processing kindness when it comes as instruction.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんがにんにくのお料理作ってくれたわ
lines.en: Sho, your grandmother made us that garlic dish we love.
lines.style: Tender warmth. The voice of someone remembering a specific comfort. Softly grateful — the kind of statement that carries quiet affection beneath it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お母さんがマヨネーズで卵サンド作ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, my mom made an egg sandwich with mayo — it was so good!
lines.style: Bright, straightforward pride. A child sharing something his mom did, simple and happy. Enthusiasm without being loud — genuine contentment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、動物園のヤギさん、可愛かったわね
lines.en: Sho, that goat at the zoo was so cute, wasn't it?
lines.style: Gentle invitation into the memory. Slightly playful — almost conspiratorial, like she's checking if he remembers the same moment she does. Warm and present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんが沖縄で泡盛を試したって聞いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I heard Dad tried awamori when he was in Okinawa.
lines.style: Quiet, thoughtful sharing. A child relaying something he's picked up, processing it carefully. Slight wonder in the pacing — the idea of his dad far away, trying something new.
